text.tspan: The workflow begins with the customer, whose calls are directed into sales and service operations.
Within Sales and Service operations, calls are received by the I3 call center.
The recordings are converted into processed dot wav files and run through a speech-to-text model
before transferring to the Hadoop Eco-system.
The Hadoop Eco-system serves as central storage, feeding data into both the
Development Cluster and the Production Cluster.
In the Development Cluster, the workflow executes data analysis, model design,
and development and test steps before feeding into production.
The Production Cluster contains the Call Satisfaction System.
This system executes data processing, batch scoring, and the business layer
to generate RSI scores in an output table.
Finally, the output is delivered directly to the manager and analyst.
